description: Product Search - Add search functionality to the shop frontend

userStories.title: Add search API endpoint
userStories.description: Create API endpoint to search products by name (EN/KH) and description
acceptanceCriteria: Accept query parameter 'q' for search term
Search in nameEn, nameKh, descriptionEn, descriptionKh fields
Return matching products with category info

userStories.title: Add search input component to shop header
userStories.description: Add a search input field in the shop header for customers to search products
acceptanceCriteria: Add search input to shop header (components/shop-header.tsx or similar)
Use Shadcn Input component with Search icon
Responsive: full width on mobile, fixed width on desktop
Placeholder text: 'Search products...' (EN) / 'ស្វែងរកផលិតផល...' (KH)

userStories.title: Implement search results dropdown
userStories.description: Show search results in a dropdown as user types
acceptanceCriteria: Show dropdown with matching products below search input
Display product image, name, and price in results
Show 'No results found' message when no matches

userStories.title: Add search result click navigation
userStories.description: Navigate to product detail page when clicking a search result
acceptanceCriteria: Click on search result navigates to /shop/product/[id]
Keyboard navigation: Enter to select highlighted result

userStories.title: Add search to translations
userStories.description: Add bilingual support for search UI text
